body:
Merged origin/main into issue/1708-straight-gap-link. This resolves the conflict in crates/app/src/operation/params.rs.

Resolution: kept main's superset trochoidal digest for the Adaptive2D arm. It uses the 0xA5 method marker and the 0xA6 trochoidal-parameter block (max_engagement, ret, return_feed, loop_width) in digest-format-valid order.

The branch's gap_link 0x4D digest was carried into mill3d.rs's Finish3D arm, because main delegates Finish3D to stamp_mill3d. The gap_link field was added to the Finish3D test initializer in setup_align_3d.rs.

Targeted gate results:
- cargo check -p camcraft-app: clean
- cargo check -p camcraft-app --tests: clean
- cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings: clean
- cargo test -p camcraft-app --test adaptive_trochoid: 12 passed
- cargo xtask gate quick: timed out after 15 minutes building test binaries; no failure attributed to this change

Pushed to fork/issue/1708-straight-gap-link (commit 004e43cfe).
Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

I cannot set labels. A collaborator must clear the conflicts label.
